paragraphs.text: Setha and Basetha were Khenra twins from Naktamun on the plane of Amonkhet , and initiates of Tah crop. Setha was the brother, and Basetha was the sister.

As part of the Tah crop, Setha and Basetha embarked upon the Trial of Ambition . While Setha was killed by swirling blades in the Trial, Basetha survived the trial as one of four, along with Djeru , Neit , and Nassor. She completed the trial by stealing the heart that Neit had cut out of another initiate.
Basetha, Neit, and Nassor were killed in different ways during the Trial of Zeal , leaving Djeru as the last survivor of Tah crop.
Basetha later became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica , and was re-killed by Samut .
